highlights: AI agents are rapidly advancing, offering robust solutions from optimizing edge-based procedural guidance to deploying hierarchical systems for online advertising, demonstrating enhanced adaptability and real-world business value.

New AI models are pushing boundaries in critical domains, including highly accurate medical diagnostics, advanced e-commerce recommendations, and physically-informed spatio-temporal forecasting, showcasing significant application-specific breakthroughs.

Developer tools and infrastructure continue to evolve, with agentic harnesses for high-performance kernel optimization, expanded capabilities for managed agent platforms, and crucial industry collaborations addressing model security and deployment efficiencies.

agents.title: ProcAgent: An Agentic Framework for Procedural Task Guidance on Edge with Human-in-the-Loop
agents.summary: ProcAgent introduces a fully on-device, vision-based agent for real-time adaptive guidance on edge hardware, utilizing a propose-and-verify architecture to offer responsive interaction and privacy-conscious assistance for complex procedural tasks.

agents.title: HOBA: Hierarchical On-Policy Bidding Agents for Adaptive Online Advertising
agents.summary: HOBA is a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for online advertising that intelligently decouples strategic reasoning and bid execution, achieving a significant +3.6% increase in target cost in large-scale online deployments by dynamically selecting optimal bidding strategies.

agents.title: RSMeM: Knowledge-Enhanced Memory Evolution for Remote Sensing Agents with Systematic Evaluation
agents.summary: RSMeM introduces a knowledge-enhanced memory mechanism for remote sensing agents, bootstrapping them with pre-distilled domain knowledge and iteratively refining online experience to achieve robust multi-step tool execution and improved accuracy on EarthBench with minimal additional tokens.

models.title: GrocLM: Grocery Category Recommendation in E-Commerce with Large Language Models
models.summary: GROCLM is a fine-tuned language model engineered for grocery category recommendation in e-commerce, employing a LoRA-based training strategy to embed cyclical purchasing patterns and demonstrating a 7.5% relative improvement in cart-adds per impression in live production.

models.title: New research shows how AMIE, our medical AI, could help manage health conditions.
models.summary: New research published in 'Nature' reveals Google's conversational AI system, AMIE, matches primary care physicians in managing complex health conditions, signaling a significant breakthrough for AI-driven medical diagnostics and personalized patient care.

models.title: Atmospheric Diffusion-Guided Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Nuclear Radiation Forecasting
models.summary: NRFormer+ presents a spatio-temporal Transformer model for nationwide nuclear radiation forecasting, integrating an atmospheric diffusion module to inject physical signals and achieve state-of-the-art accuracy by effectively modeling non-stationary temporal and density-adaptive spatial dynamics.

tools.title: Kernel Forge: An Agent Harness for LLM-based Generation and Optimization of CUDA Kernels
tools.summary: Kernel Forge is an open-source agentic harness that leverages LLMs and Monte Carlo Tree Search to generate and optimize CUDA kernels for PyTorch models, achieving significant speedups (e.g., 2.83x on softmax) across diverse workloads and providing a GUI for monitoring and debugging.

tools.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more
tools.summary: Google announces expanded capabilities for Managed Agents in Gemini API, including support for Gemini 3.6 Flash and advanced hooks, empowering developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents with enhanced control and flexibility.

tools.title: Introducing OpenAI Presence
tools.summary: OpenAI launches Presence, an enterprise AI agent platform designed to help organizations securely deploy trusted voice and chat agents for customer service and internal workflow automation, streamlining business processes with proven AI capabilities.

companies.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face partner to address security incident during model evaluation
companies.summary: OpenAI and Hugging Face collaborated to investigate a security incident during AI model evaluation, sharing early findings to highlight advanced cyber capabilities and provide crucial lessons for enhancing AI security practices.

companies.title: Launching Health in ChatGPT
companies.summary: OpenAI introduces 'Health in ChatGPT,' allowing eligible U.S. users to securely connect medical records and Apple Health, enabling personalized health insights and a better understanding of their well-being directly through the platform.

companies.title: Scientific computing in the age of agentic AI
companies.summary: OpenAI highlights a new field report demonstrating how AI coding agents are revolutionizing scientific computing, accelerating software development and discovery in genomics and other scientific domains, underscoring the transformative impact of agentic AI.

learning.title: New York City educators and industry leaders gathered at Google’s offices to shape the future of AI in classrooms.
learning.summary: Google, in collaboration with the New York Jobs CEO Council and Urban Assembly, hosted an AI summit for 150 education and industry leaders, fostering discussions to shape the future of AI integration and curriculum development in classrooms.

learning.title: Profiling in PyTorch (Part 3): Attention is all you profile
learning.summary: Hugging Face provides a detailed technical guide on advanced profiling techniques in PyTorch, specifically focusing on optimizing and understanding the performance implications of attention mechanisms within AI models to enhance efficiency.

learning.title: Ask an AI expert: What exactly is the full stack?
learning.summary: A Google expert offers a comprehensive explanation of the 'full-stack' approach to AI, elucidating its foundational role and significance in developing robust and scalable artificial intelligence systems.
